requirement.description: View class __getattr__ method does not properly handle reserved field names with underscore prefixes.
requirement.contract: When accessing a reserved field name (starting with underscore) via attribute access on a View, it should raise an AttributeError with a specific message format: "View of (sig $signal) field '<field_name>' has a reserved name and may only be accessed by indexing"

requirement.description: View class __getattr__ method does not provide helpful field name suggestions for missing fields.
requirement.contract: When accessing a non-existent field via attribute access on a View, it should raise an AttributeError with message format: "View of (sig $signal) does not have a field '<field_name>'; did you mean one of: <suggestions>?"

requirement.description: View class __getitem__ method does not properly validate indexing with non-Value types for non-array layouts.
requirement.contract: When indexing a View with a non-Value type for a non-array layout, it should raise a TypeError with message format: "Only views with array layout, not <layout_type>, may be indexed with a value"

requirement.description: Enum class does not format warning messages consistently with expected test format.
requirement.contract: When raising warnings for shape mismatches, the error messages should match the exact format expected by tests, including proper representation of enum values and consistent escaping.

requirement.description: Struct and Union classes do not properly handle inheritance from base classes with methods.
requirement.contract: When a Struct or Union class inherits from a base class with methods, those methods should be accessible without AttributeError when the class is used with Signal constructor.
